value: Purine and pyrimidine metabolism gene families
biomarker_name.evidence_quote: Bacteroidetes decreased, Th1, Th17 and B cells have been previously implicated in RA pathogenesis, DAS28 score was greater than 2 at baseline
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified across immune cell populations and microbiota taxa associated with MTX response.

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: MTX (1.7–900 μg/ml, 2–2,000 μM), DAS28 score improved by at least 1.8, percentage of cells or fold change percentage
biomarker_unit.notes: Units correspond to biomarker types: relative abundance for taxa, scores for clinical outcomes, percentages/fold changes for immune cells, μg/ml or μM for drug concentrations.

biomarker_value.evidence_quote: MTX significantly decreased Bacteroidetes phylum, DAS28 improved by at least 1.8 by month 4, 11–33% of tested isolates inhibited, 7 immunocyte populations were significantly lower in post-MTX recipients
biomarker_value.notes: Values represent quantitative measurements of biomarker changes in response to MTX treatment across different experimental systems.

disease_response_os.notes: This is a rheumatoid arthritis treatment study, not an oncology study with overall survival endpoints. The paper focuses on disease response measured by DAS28 scores, not mortality.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Overall survival not applicable to this rheumatoid arthritis study.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not reported in this rheumatoid arthritis microbiome study. Disease activity measured using DAS28 score instead.

feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: MTX significantly impaired growth of complex microbial communities, significant decrease in richness, shift in community structure, Bacteroidetes decreased, Actinobacteria increased, High-dose MTX altered 14 bacterial genera and 81 amplicon sequence variants
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal phenotypes extensively characterized through 16S sequencing, metagenomics, and metabolomics showing microbiota composition changes with MTX treatment.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable to this rheumatoid arthritis microbiome study. Study does not involve tumor measurements.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this is a rheumatoid arthritis study without oncology endpoints.

value: Study examined gnotobiotic mice colonized with human stool samples

45 bacterial isolates tested (42 from human gut, 3 controls)

uncurated_metadata.notes: Comprehensive study design combining in vitro, gnotobiotic mouse, and human clinical cohort experiments with extensive metadata on experimental conditions and participant characteristics.

extraction_warnings: Paper primarily describes experimental study in gnotobiotic mice and ex vivo studies rather than cohort of human participants with individual samples. Sample-level data not available from text.
Clinical cohort (n=23-30 RA patients) included but participant identifiers, age, and sex not individually reported.
Multiple subgroups defined by experimental design, donor source, and clinical response rather than traditional categorical metadata.
Gnotobiotic mouse experiments used human donor stool samples but mice themselves are not human subjects.
Antibiotic exclusion period applies only to clinical RA patient cohort, not to healthy donor or mouse experiments.
DNA extraction kits varied by experiment type: MoBio for NYU RA 16S, ZymoBIOMICS for shotgun sequencing, Wizard SV 96 for initial mouse experiments.
NCBI accession PRJNA656577 covers all sequencing data; individual sample accessions in SRA database.
